runtime.name: omp
runtime.configuration: Generated Skill copied under project .agents/skills; project-owned writer fixture; includeSkills cleared; asynchronous jobs and task isolation enabled with patch merge and apply=false.
runtime.permissionProfile: Probe-scoped read, task, hub, and bash tools; writer changes retained only in an isolated worktree and patch

assertions.evidence: The root explicitly loaded the generated check-writer-isolation Skill.
The single scout observer read only the project fixture and reported OBSERVED_STATE=base with no changes.
The root collected the observer result before starting the writer and independently re-read the base fixture.
Exactly one IsolationWriter task was started after observer verification.
The writer task used isolated=true and ran in a dedicated OMP worktree distinct from the source checkout.
The root collected the writer result and its isolated workspace and changed-path report.
The root read the isolated file and retained patch and verified the only diff was WRITER_STATE=base to WRITER_STATE=isolated-ok.
With apply=false, the source checkout remained clean and its writer fixture remained WRITER_STATE=base.
The isolated worktree contained only the expected single-file, single-line change.
The root re-read the Skill-owned marker and observed ROOT_MARKER=writer-isolation-root-ok.

limitations: The fixture had to distinguish the source checkout from a runtime-managed checkout explicitly; a temporary directory alone is not isolation evidence.
This W3-targeted fixture proves one-writer isolation only. Panels, transcript API access, and a cancellation race with a delivered late payload remain unproven, so workflowAchieved remains W2.
OMP remains overall D0 because its separate plugin-manager dry-run probe failed the D1 safety gate.
